## Summary:

Significant interplanetary shock detected by ACE and DSCOVR at L1 at 2024-06-28T09:09Z. 

The shock is caused by CME with ID 2024-06-25T05:00:00-CME-001 (see notification 20240625-AL-001). Strong magnetospheric compression possible and moderate geomagnetic storm observed in synoptic period 2024-06-28T09:00Z-T12:00Z.
